_schema.generated: ISO timestamp of the daily refresh; the page shows it and flags >=2d stale
_schema.tickers: map of ticker id -> array of news items, any order (the page sorts newest-first and filters to the last 7 days)

item.date: YYYY-MM-DD, the day the news broke (the page joins this to own price data for the 1d move)
item.headline: one line, what happened
item.why: optional, one line on why it matters for this name
item.src: publication or filing the item came from - required for anything asserted as fact

NVDA.headline: Definitive agreement to acquire Hugging Face
NVDA.why: ~$11.9B payable to Hugging Face stockholders plus up to ~$1.0B of equity-based retention for employees joining NVIDIA; close expected 1H 2027 subject to regulatory approvals.

AAPL.headline: John Ternus takes over as CEO from Tim Cook
AAPL.why: The Sept 9 iPhone event is the first product launch under the new CEO.

AAPL.headline: Six new products expected at the Sept 9 “Surprise and Shine” event
AAPL.why: iPhone 18 Pro on the A20 Pro, a book-style foldable iPhone Ultra, new Apple Watch and AirPods — press preview, not confirmed by Apple.

META.headline: Muse Voice Transcribe launched
META.why: Meta's first real-time audio perception model; 70+ languages and 20+ speaker diarization, shipping in the Meta AI macOS app.

META.headline: Muse Spark 1.3 released and opened to paid developers
META.why: Zuckerberg called it Meta's biggest jump yet in coding and agentic work; rolls out to Instagram, Facebook and Meta AI.

MSFT.headline: Will disclose Azure revenue in dollars every quarter for the first time
MSFT.why: Operating segments cut from three to two, replacing the structure in place since 2015 — the segment tables on this page change shape from the next filing.

GOOGL.headline: Gemini 3.8 Flash launched, the third Flash model in six weeks
GOOGL.why: Priced at $0.75/M input and $3.75/M output tokens, matching the prior Flash model; paired with a Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber model aimed at government and enterprise.

AMD.headline: Instinct MI355X infrastructure live in Saudi Arabia with Cisco and HUMAIN
AMD.why: Partners flag up to 250MW more beginning 2027, toward as much as 1GW by 2030; first-phase revenue is small against a ~$13B quarter.

AVGO.headline: Q3 FY2026: revenue $29.59B (+86% YoY), AI semiconductor revenue $16.7B (+221% YoY)
AVGO.why: FY2026 AI revenue guidance raised to ~$58B; management targets ~$115B in FY2027 and ~$230B in FY2028.

AVGO.headline: Q4 guidance $34.8B against ~$35.03B consensus
AVGO.why: Guide landed just below expectations despite the quarter's beat.

AVGO.headline: Truist cut its price target to $520 from $550

INTC.headline: Backing the ASML/TSMC 12-inch photomask initiative
INTC.why: Intel and Samsung joined the industry push to large-format masks for High-NA EUV.

TSM.headline: Joint initiative with ASML to move the industry to 12-inch photomasks for High-NA EUV
TSM.why: Targets a 12-inch mask pilot line by 2031 and lithography readiness for advanced-node production by 2033; TSMC plans High-NA EUV in high-volume manufacturing from 2030.

ASML.headline: Joint initiative with TSMC to move the industry to 12-inch photomasks for High-NA EUV
ASML.why: Pilot line targeted for 2031, full lithography readiness for advanced-node production by 2033; announced ahead of the SPIE Bacus conference, with other High-NA adopters expressing interest in joining.

MU.headline: Closed at $1,016.59, up 256% year to date
MU.why: Record DRAM contract pricing and AI datacenter memory demand; management has flagged a meaningful moderation in the rate of price increases in fiscal Q4, which reports later this month.

9988.headline: June-quarter quick-commerce losses narrowed as delivery discounting eased
9988.why: Alibaba and JD both narrowed losses while Meituan clawed back profit; improving profit outlooks may draw back investors put off by the price war.

3690.headline: Clawed back profit in the June quarter as delivery discounting eased
3690.why: Alibaba and JD narrowed their quick-commerce losses over the same period; improving profit outlooks may draw back investors put off by the price war.

9618.headline: June-quarter quick-commerce losses narrowed as delivery discounting eased
9618.why: JD and Alibaba both narrowed losses while Meituan clawed back profit; improving profit outlooks may draw back investors put off by the price war.
